```{=html}
{{< include _navbar.html >}}

<!-- ── Reset Password Page ────────────────────────────────── -->
<div class="auth-page">
  <div class="auth-card">
    <img src="assets/logo.png" alt="AAIC Logo" class="auth-logo">

    <!-- Phase 1: Request reset link (shown by default) -->
    <div id="requestPhase">
      <h2>Reset Password</h2>
      <p class="auth-subtitle">Enter your email to receive a reset link</p>
      <div id="requestMsg" class="auth-message" style="display:none;"></div>
      <form id="requestForm" onsubmit="return false;">
        <label for="resetEmail">Email</label>
        <input type="email" id="resetEmail" placeholder="Enter your email" required>
        <button type="submit" class="auth-btn" id="requestBtn">Send Reset Link</button>
      </form>
      <div class="auth-links">
        <a href="login-teacher.html">Back to Log In</a>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Phase 2: Set new password (shown when user arrives from email link) -->
    <div id="updatePhase" style="display:none;">
      <h2>Set New Password</h2>
      <p class="auth-subtitle">Choose a new password for your account</p>
      <div id="updateMsg" class="auth-message" style="display:none;"></div>
      <form id="updateForm" onsubmit="return false;">
        <label for="newPassword">New Password</label>
        <input type="password" id="newPassword" placeholder="Enter new password (min 6 characters)" required minlength="6">
        <label for="confirmPassword">Confirm Password</label>
        <input type="password" id="confirmPassword" placeholder="Confirm new password" required minlength="6">
        <button type="submit" class="auth-btn" id="updateBtn">Update Password</button>
      </form>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>

<!-- ── Popup overlay for success ──────────────────────────── -->
<div id="resetPopup" class="popup-overlay" style="display:none;">
  <div class="popup-card">
    <h3>Password Updated</h3>
    <p>Your password has been updated successfully. You can now log in with your new password.</p>
    <button class="auth-btn" onclick="window.location.href='login-teacher.html';">Go to Log In</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  function initResetPage() {
    if (typeof _supabase === 'undefined' || !_supabase) {
      setTimeout(initResetPage, 200);
      return;
    }

    // Check if the user arrived via a reset link (URL contains access_token or type=recovery)
    var hash = window.location.hash;
    var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    var isRecovery = hash.includes('type=recovery') || params.get('type') === 'recovery';

    // Also check if there's already a session (user clicked the email link)
    _supabase.auth.getSession().then(function(result) {
      var session = result.data.session;

      if (isRecovery || (session && hash.includes('access_token'))) {
        // Show the "set new password" form
        document.getElementById('requestPhase').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('updatePhase').style.display = 'block';
      }
    });

    // Also listen for auth events (Supabase fires PASSWORD_RECOVERY when user clicks email link)
    _supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(function(event, session) {
      if (event === 'PASSWORD_RECOVERY') {
        document.getElementById('requestPhase').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('updatePhase').style.display = 'block';
      }
    });

    // ── Phase 1: Request reset link ──
    document.getElementById('requestForm').addEventListener('submit', function() {
      var btn = document.getElementById('requestBtn');
      var msgEl = document.getElementById('requestMsg');
      var email = document.getElementById('resetEmail').value.trim();

      if (!email) return;

      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.textContent = 'Sending...';
      msgEl.style.display = 'none';

      _supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {
        redirectTo: window.location.origin + '/reset-password.html'
      }).then(function(result) {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = 'Send Reset Link';

        if (result.error) {
          msgEl.textContent = result.error.message;
          msgEl.className = 'auth-message error';
          msgEl.style.display = 'block';
        } else {
          msgEl.textContent = 'If an account exists with that email, a reset link has been sent. Check your inbox.';
          msgEl.className = 'auth-message success';
          msgEl.style.display = 'block';
        }
      });
    });

    // ── Phase 2: Set new password ──
    document.getElementById('updateForm').addEventListener('submit', function() {
      var btn = document.getElementById('updateBtn');
      var msgEl = document.getElementById('updateMsg');
      var password = document.getElementById('newPassword').value;
      var confirm = document.getElementById('confirmPassword').value;

      if (!password || !confirm) return;

      if (password.length < 6) {
        msgEl.textContent = 'Password must be at least 6 characters.';
        msgEl.className = 'auth-message error';
        msgEl.style.display = 'block';
        return;
      }

      if (password !== confirm) {
        msgEl.textContent = 'Passwords do not match.';
        msgEl.className = 'auth-message error';
        msgEl.style.display = 'block';
        return;
      }

      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.textContent = 'Updating...';
      msgEl.style.display = 'none';

      _supabase.auth.updateUser({ password: password }).then(function(result) {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = 'Update Password';

        if (result.error) {
          msgEl.textContent = result.error.message;
          msgEl.className = 'auth-message error';
          msgEl.style.display = 'block';
        } else {
          // Sign out so they can log in fresh with new password
          _supabase.auth.signOut().then(function() {
            document.getElementById('resetPopup').style.display = 'flex';
          });
        }
      });
    });
  }

  initResetPage();
})();
</script>
```
